newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Bossi to stand trial on contempt charges.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Bossi to stand trial on contempt charges.

text.p: Umberto Bossi, leader of the separatist Northern League, was ordered on Wednesday to stand trial on charges of contempt towards Italy's president, judicial sources said.

The charges stem from remarks Bossi made at a political rally in which he said President Oscar Luigi Scalfaro had put pressure on magistrates not to investigate leaders of the ex communist Democratic Party of the Left (PDS).
Judge Fabio Paparella had asked parliament to rule if Bossi had made his remarks in his capacity as a parliamentarian and therefore should not be tried.
Contempt for the head of state is against the law in Italy.
Paparella decided to order the trial after parliament failed to make a ruling despite several extensions of a deadline the judge had set for a response.
The trial is scheduled to start next October 30 in Milan.
